name: Gyarados
flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

levelUp.name: Thrash
levelUp.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

levelUp.name: Bite
levelUp.description: The foe is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

levelUp.name: Dragon Rage
levelUp.description: The foe is stricken by a shock wave. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

levelUp.name: Leer
levelUp.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

levelUp.name: Twister
levelUp.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

levelUp.name: Ice Fang
levelUp.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

levelUp.name: Aqua Tail
levelUp.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

levelUp.name: Rain Dance
levelUp.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

levelUp.name: Hydro Pump
levelUp.description: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

levelUp.name: Dragon Dance
levelUp.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

levelUp.name: Hyper Beam
levelUp.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tutor.name: Dive
tutor.description: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.

tutor.name: Icy Wind
tutor.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

tutor.name: Iron Head
tutor.description: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Aqua Tail
tutor.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Spite
tutor.description: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

tutor.name: Outrage
tutor.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

tutor.name: Twister
tutor.description: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Bounce
tutor.description: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

tutor.name: Uproar
tutor.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
